run_validate_raw_schema: run the validate_raw_schema function to validate a JSON document against the RAW schema
run_validate_ann_schema: run the validate_ann_schema function to validate a JSON document against the ANN schema
run_validate_ocr_schema: run the validate_ocr_schema function to validate a JSON document against the OCR schema
run_validate_cli: run the validate CLI module to validate a JSON file with format RAW, ANN, or OCR
test_parse_arguments: test the parse_arguments function to parse command line arguments for format and input file
